operating_notes.text: Isgec Eswatini (Proprietary) Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, holds an existing order requiring performance and customs bonds of up to USD 1.1957 million, backed by parent guarantees approved on 1 May 2026.
Agreement entered to sell 25% stake in Isgec SFW Boilers Private Limited to Sumitomo SHI FW Energia OY for ₹4 crore, changing its status from subsidiary to associate.
Delhi GST authorities levied a ₹37,74,378 demand (tax ₹20,70,589, penalty ₹2,20,112, interest ₹14,83,677) alleging excess FY2022-23 input tax credit; Isgec will appeal.

ICRA reaffirmed ₹5,550 Cr of rated bank facilities — ₹600 Cr fund-based, ₹3,800.17 Cr non-fund based, ₹1,099.83 Cr fund/non-fund and ₹50 Cr term loan — at [ICRA]AA (Stable)/[ICRA]A1+, unchanged from 27.03.2025.
CBPI Philippines reclassified back to continuing operations in FY26 consolidated financials with a depreciation impact of ₹1,699 Mn in FY26 and ₹595 Mn in FY25.
Issued a counter guarantee of ₹8.58 Cr (USD 0.902 million) for subsidiary Isgec Eswatini (Proprietary) Limited.
Export order book was ₹1,450 Cr as on 31 March 2026; export revenue was ₹1,169 Cr in FY26, about 22% of total revenue.
Isgec Hitachi Zosen had orders in hand of ₹763 Cr as on 31 March 2026, with FY26 total income of ₹672 Cr and PBT of ₹103 Cr.
Philippines ethanol plant sold 4.35 million litres of ethanol between April and May 2026 and has contracts with 6 oil companies.
ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]A (Stable)/[ICRA]A2+ on Isgec Hitachi Zosen's ₹905 Cr limits; working-capital facilities ₹845 Cr plus ₹60 Cr unallocated.

timeline.summary: Aditya Puri, Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited’s promoter, declared no encumbrance on promoter group’s shares as of March 31, 2026.
Isgec Heavy Engineering announced the results of its postal ballot approving key managerial re-appointments on March 28, 2026.
On 1 May 2026 Isgec's board approved guarantees and SBLCs of up to USD 1.1957 million (₹11.23 Cr) for its wholly owned Eswatini subsidiary's bankers, to back bonds for its existing order.
Isgec Heavy Engineering agreed to sell a 25% stake in Isgec SFW Boilers to Sumitomo SHI FW Energia OY for ₹4 crore, reducing its holding to 26%.

On 15 May 2026 Isgec Heavy Engineering disclosed a ₹37.74 lakh GST demand from Delhi's Assistant Commissioner/GSTO, Ward 62, Zone 5, over alleged excess FY2022-23 input tax credit, and said it will appeal.
2026-05-21: Isgec Heavy Engineering received a ₹2.77 Cr customs duty demand and ₹2.77 Cr penalty order over an HSN classification dispute.
On 26 May 2026 ICRA reaffirmed Isgec Heavy Engineering's ratings at [ICRA]AA (Stable)/[ICRA]A1+ on ₹5,550 Cr of bank facilities, unchanged from the March 2025 communication.
Isgec Heavy Engineering reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,675 Cr and PAT of ₹101 Cr, recommended a ₹6/share dividend, and approved ₹25 Cr capex.
Isgec Heavy Engineering reclassified Cavite Biofuel Producers Inc. back to continuing operations, reporting FY26 consolidated total income of ₹6,922.3 Cr.
Isgec Heavy Engineering issued an ₹8.58 Cr counter guarantee for its wholly owned subsidiary Isgec Eswatini (Proprietary) Limited.
2026-06-03: Isgec Heavy Engineering filed the transcript of its 29 May Q4 & FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 standalone revenue growth of 10-12% on a ₹7,000 Cr opening order book.
93rd AGM held on September 28, 2026, transcript uploaded on October 5, 2026
2026-10-13: ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]A (Stable)/[ICRA]A2+ on Isgec Hitachi Zosen's ₹905 Cr bank limits, unchanged from September 2025.
Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited will hold an Analysts/Investors Conference Call/Meet on Thursday, November 05, 2026, at 04:00 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).
